Interface ClientDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientCloudDAO, ClientJsonDAO
public interface ClientDAO
Data Access Object interface for Customer entities. Defines the contract for all client persistence operations.

  • Method Details

    • isFileCreated

      boolean isFileCreated()
      Returns whether the backing persistence file exists on disk.
      Returns:
      true if the file exists, false otherwise

    • createIfNotExists

      void createIfNotExists() throws PersistenceException
      Creates the backing persistence file if it does not already exist. Implementations should initialise the file with an empty structure (e.g. []).
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the file cannot be created

    • findById

      Customer findById(String id) throws PersistenceException
      Returns the client with the given ID, or null if not found.
      Parameters:
      id - the client ID to look up
      Returns:
      the matching Customer, or null
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the data source cannot be accessed

    • save

      void save(Customer client) throws PersistenceException
      Persists a new client record to the backing storage.
      Parameters:
      client - the Customer to save
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the client cannot be written

    • findAll

      List<Customer> findAll(String id) throws PersistenceException
      Returns all client records from the backing storage. The id parameter is reserved for implementations that scope results to a group or session; pass null to retrieve all clients.
      Parameters:
      id - optional scoping identifier (may be null)
      Returns:
      a list of all Customer objects; never null
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the data source cannot be accessed

    • findByFields

      List<Customer> findByFields(String id, String field, String value) throws PersistenceException
      Returns all clients whose given field matches the given value.
      Parameters:
      id - optional scoping identifier (may be null)
      field - the field name to filter on (e.g. "clientId", "full_name")
      value - the value the field must equal
      Returns:
      a list of matching Customer objects; never null
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the data source cannot be accessed

    • removeClients

      boolean removeClients(String id, String field, String value) throws PersistenceException
      Removes all clients whose given field matches the given value.
      Parameters:
      id - optional scoping identifier (may be null)
      field - the field name to match
      value - the value the field must equal
      Returns:
      true if at least one client was removed, false otherwise
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the data source cannot be accessed or written

    • removeClient

      boolean removeClient(String id, String pos) throws PersistenceException
      Removes the single client identified by the given position or ID.
      Parameters:
      id - optional scoping identifier (may be null)
      pos - the client ID (or positional key) of the record to remove
      Returns:
      true if the client was found and removed, false otherwise
      Throws:
      PersistenceException - if the data source cannot be accessed or written
